descriptions.d24c_input_post_8byte_800f8a48: Build a 12-byte record with vtable 0x80410500, id and value; push it on the vector at +124 of the 0x804aaf48 service when +428 is non-zero, else on the vector at +28, growing by reallocation through 0x80212fd4 with fallback 0x803413d8 and freeing the old block through 0x802134fc; then call 0x800f8dcc with the service and the record.
